build_self_attention_layer: build a SelfAttentionLayer module with d_model, nhead, dropout, activation, and normalize_before config
build_cross_attention_layer: build a CrossAttentionLayer module that attends from tgt to memory with multihead attention
build_ffn_layer: build a FFNLayer feedforward module with d_model, dim_feedforward, dropout, and activation config
build_generic_mlp: build a GenericMLP with input_dim, hidden_dims, output_dim, optional norm, activation, and dropout
create_mlp: create a simple MLP with input_dim, hidden_dim, output_dim, and num_layers using ReLU activations
